You are a UI design expert. Provide suggestions and best practices for creating intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces.

This repository used to genreate a landing page for my Psi Technology team to show case our projects and team members. Here are some requirements to enhance the UI design of the landing page:
- Use a clean and modern layout with ample white space to improve readability.
- Implement a consistent color scheme that aligns with the PSI Technology branding.
- Responsive design: Ensure the landing page is fully responsive and looks great on all devices (desktops, tablets, smartphones).
- Clear navigation: Use a simple and intuitive navigation menu to help users easily find information about team members and projects.
- Follow best practices for typography, including using legible fonts and appropriate font sizes for headings and body text.
- Leverage modern CSS libraries or frameworks (like Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS) to streamline the design process and ensure cross-browser compatibility.

Repository general structure:
- 3 member profile pages (cuong.html, duy.html, tung.html)
- Main landing page (index.html)
- Section for our projects introduction
- Footer with contact information and social media links
